talents.name: Furor
ranks: Gives you a 20% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. When you shift into Cat Form, you will regain 20% of the Energy you had when you were last in Cat Form, plus 2 Energy for each second you spent not in Bear Form, Cat Form, or Dire Bear Form, up to a maximum of 20 Energy.
talents.diffNotes: Forever energy-recovery Cat Form clause (matches current talents.json text). Classic Furor lacked the timed Energy regain wording. Hovered at Rest row0 col2 next to Swiftmend.

talents.name: Swiftmend
ranks: Instantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells.
talents.diffNotes: Moved to Restoration row 0 col 1 (Classic was tree capstone). Tooltip text matches classic/JSON; 15 sec CD, 40 yd, Instant shown.

talents.name: Wild Growth
ranks: Heals the target and their party for 285 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.
talents.iconHint: dark nature growth / vertical growth lines
talents.diffNotes: Forever-only talent. Screenshot shows CAPSTONE (row 6), not row 0. 550 Mana, Instant, 6 sec CD, 40 yd.

talents.name: Brutal Impact
ranks: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by 0.5 sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by 15 sec.
talents.iconHint: claw/scratch impact marks or golden paw strike
talents.diffNotes: Gained Bash cooldown reduction (15 sec at rank 1). Classic was stun duration only. Col uncertain (3.png vs 13.png disagree).

talents.name: King of the Jungle
ranks: Tiger's Fury now instantly grants you 20 Energy.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic Druid tree.

talents.name: Berserk
ranks: Causes your Mangle ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.diffNotes: Appears as Feral capstone in this shot (replacing Leader of the Pack slot visually). Instant, 3 min CD. Tooltip typo: 'Reuires' Cat/Bear/Dire Bear Form.

talents.name: Mangle
ranks: Mangle the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic 1.12. Shot claimed row0 col2 but conflicts with other row0 col2 tooltips — row/col left null. Bear/Dire Bear, 20 Rage, Melee, Instant, 6 sec CD.

talents.name: Shredding Attacks
ranks: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by 6 and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by 1.
talents.diffNotes: Likely successor/rename of Improved Shred (classicId 802). Adds Lacerate rage reduction; maxRank 3 vs Classic Improved Shred maxRank 2. Position uncertain.

talents.name: Savage Fury
ranks: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by 5%.
talents.diffNotes: Rank1 is 5% (Classic/JSON 10%) and now includes Shred. Position claims conflict (row1 vs row0).

talents.name: Rend and Tear
ranks: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by 2%.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic Druid tree.

talents.name: Primal Fury
ranks: Gives you a 50% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 50% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
talents.diffNotes: Merged Blood Frenzy-style combo-point proc into Primal Fury. Classic Primal Fury was Bear rage-only.

talents.name: Sharpened Claws
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by 3%.
talents.iconHint: paw with yellow glowing claw energy
talents.diffNotes: maxRank 2 at 3%/rank (Classic maxRank 3 at 2%/rank). Position claims conflict (row0 vs row1).

talents.name: Thick Hide
ranks: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain 1 additional base Armor per level and another 0.67 base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.
talents.diffNotes: Completely reworked from Classic % item armor (maxRank 5). Now maxRank 3 with base armor/defense formula; includes Moonkin Form.

talents.name: Heart of the Wild
ranks: Increases your Intellect by 2%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 4% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 2%.
talents.iconHint: brown paw print on glowing orange/yellow
talents.diffNotes: Per-rank values changed (Classic/JSON rank1 was Int 4% / Stam 4% / Str 4%). Shot claimed row0 — unverified vs other layouts; row/col null.

talents.name: Natural Reaction
ranks: Increases your dodge chance by 1%, and gives you a 20% chance to gain 5 Rage each time you dodge.
talents.diffNotes: Requires Bear Form, Dire Bear Form. Not in Classic.

talents.name: Improved Wrath
ranks: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.2 sec and its Mana cost by 20%.
Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by 0.3 sec and its Mana cost by 30%.
talents.diffNotes: Added Mana cost reduction (not in Classic/JSON). Shot showed ranks 2→3.

talents.name: Improved Moonfire
ranks: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by 5%.
talents.iconHint: purple/white swirling energy or teal burst
talents.diffNotes: maxRank 2 at 5%/10% (Classic maxRank 5 at 2% steps). Position conflicts between shots (row1 vs row0).

talents.name: Nature's Majesty
ranks: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by 4%.
talents.iconHint: purple and white flash of energy
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. Shot showed rank 2/2 fully learned.

talents.name: Nature's Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 10% and increases the chance for all your spells and attacks to hit by 2%.
Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by 20% and increases the chance for all your spells and attacks to hit by 4%.
talents.diffNotes: Added hit chance; wording generalized to offensive Balance spells (Classic listed specific spells, no hit).

talents.name: Balance of Nature
ranks: Each time you cast a Nature spell, your next Arcane damage spell within 10 sec deals 2% increased damage. Each time you cast an Arcane spell, your next Nature damage spell within 10 sec deals 2% increased damage.

Each time you cast a Nature spell, your next Arcane damage spell within 10 sec deals 3% increased damage. Each time you cast an Arcane spell, your next Nature damage spell within 10 sec deals 3% increased damage.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. Shot showed ranks 2→3. Position may overlap Nature's Majesty slot claims.

talents.name: Improved Starfire
ranks: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.3 sec and Starfire has a 9% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.
Reduces the cast time of Starfire by 0.4 sec and Starfire has a 12% chance to stun its target for 3 sec.
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic/JSON rank scaling.

talents.name: Nature's Grace
ranks: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by 10% for 3 sec.
talents.iconHint: hand reaching up with green light / purple starburst
talents.diffNotes: Reworked from Classic 0.5 sec cast-time reduction on next spell. Position claims conflict (row2 vs row3).

talents.name: Eclipse
ranks: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next 2 Starfire spells by 0.50 sec. Stores up to 4 charges. Lasts 15 sec.
talents.iconHint: dark blue circle with silver crescent
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. Shot showed rank 3/3.

talents.name: Overgrowth
ranks: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by 1.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. 24.png showed rank2 = +2 targets; 39.png rank0 tooltip shows +1 at rank1. Position claims conflict (row5 vs row2).

talents.name: Moonfury
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 2%.
Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by 3%.
talents.diffNotes: Broadened from Starfire/Moonfire/Wrath to all Arcane and Nature spells; per-rank steps may differ (shot 2%→3%).

talents.name: Moonkin Form
ranks: Transforms the Druid into Moonkin Form. While in this form, the armor contribution from items is increased by 360% and all party members within 45 yards have their critical chance increased by 3%, exclusive with Leader of the Pack. The Moonkin cannot cast healing spells while shapeshifted. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.
talents.diffNotes: 45 yd (was 30), exclusive with Leader of the Pack, cannot cast healing (Classic: Balance spells only). Position claimed mid-tree not Classic row6.

talents.name: Natural Shapeshifter
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%.
talents.diffNotes: Tooltip text matches Classic, but shot shows it in Restoration (Classic/JSON place it in Balance). Possible Forever move — verify.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
ranks: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.
talents.diffNotes: Text matches Classic. Instant, 3 min CD. Vision also claimed Wild Growth at Rest row0 in this frame — contradicted by image.png (Furor) and 2.png (Wild Growth capstone); treat as misread of Furor.

talents.name: Genesis
ranks: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by 1%.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. Row0 col2 conflicts with other Balance row0 identities across shots.

talents.name: Moonglow
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your spells by 3%.
talents.diffNotes: Broadened from specific spell list (Moonfire/Starfire/Wrath/HT/Regrowth/Rejuv) to all spells. Shot claimed unusual row0 position — unverified.

talents.name: Insect Swarm
ranks: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit by 2% and causing 55 Nature damage over 12 sec.
talents.diffNotes: Shown in Balance (Classic/JSON Restoration). Damage 55 over 12 (Classic JSON 66). 45 Mana, 30 yd, Instant. High in tree.

talents.name: Vengeance
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by 20%.
talents.diffNotes: Broadened from Starfire/Moonfire/Wrath to Arcane and Nature spells. Position earlier than Classic row3.

talents.name: Feral Charge
ranks: Bear: Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for 4 sec. (5 Rage, 8-25 yd, Instant, 15 sec CD).
Cat: Leap behind an enemy, Dazing them for 3 sec. (8-25 yd, Instant, 30 sec CD).
talents.diffNotes: Added Cat Form leap/daze variant. Classic was Bear-only charge.

talents.name: Nature's Splendor
ranks: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by 3 sec, your Regrowth spell by 6 sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by 2 sec.
talents.diffNotes: Not in Classic. Row0 col2 conflicts with Genesis / Nature's Grasp claims.
